name: Gran Woodfall
original_name: グラン・ウッドフォール
source:
"I'm well aware. You're here because of that 'curse,' after all."

A brooding and tight-lipped young nobleman, he rules over the Woodfall Barony, a land blanketed in misty forests to the east of the Kingdom of Winstoll. A curse has twisted his right arm into a monstrous limb, granting him the power to shape-shift it and wield incredible strength. He has brought Princess Sylphia into his castle as his betrothed to conduct a specific ritual.
